adjudicated.ruling: The lexical accent is restored in the working text under the edition's house convention; the witness's capital typography is recorded exactly.

This edition accents capitals, by the house rule in ORTHOGRAPHY.md, because the accent tells a reader where the stress falls and a capital does not stop being a syllable. Most printings omit them; the reading is identical.
The approved Benziger printing's punctuation is retained. The difference marks phrasing and does not change the words.
